notes.title: Development Update 24/08/25
notes.content:
[p]Ahoy everyone![/p][p]We're happy to share some progress on our Crew Deck Layout System! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2][p]In Solar Sails, crew members operate the different battle stations on the ship. A crew member assigned to a station contributes their active and passive abilities to its functionality. Different layouts of crew members assigned to stations offer a variety of play styles, each providing a distinct set of abilities. [/p][p][/p][p]Are you a flanker who relies on speed and agility? Or a tactician who snipes enemies from afar? Or do you prefer to go in cannons blazing? You can try different builds by creating different crew layouts on the ship. 
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXck8hfItWZa3-vjigXkf2xhAm-YsVdgm_KTNJ9sbxAs8oa7ybOZDXbG5iki2uCi_e1SUPsxLxw7JjjwZmCwU2Qjehae7wcS5y6GA_D-F5CoKVQwPGKkIwVcP1CxtcdaQZokFK3KpFFHj_77a6720r-03InxVO4?key=IpYmreUZadLWYYEh84XT1w"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Ship’s Stations[/b][/h2][p]The ship has several stations, each serving a purpose. Stations must be manned by crew members to function. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Steering: [/b][/p][p]Responsible for the ship’s movement and maneuvering.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weaponry: [/b][/p][p]The station that controls all the weapons installed along the ship.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Deck (x3): [/b][/p][p]Serve as supporting assault stations. Every crew member on the deck increases the ship’s attack speed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Drone: [/b][/p][p]A remotely-controlled drone used to magnetize and release objects. Useful for setting explosive traps and tossing objects at enemies. Grants a special weapon slot on top of the drone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mast: [/b][/p][p]A cozy place for a mast bird, which allows it to spot treasure, traps, and hidden objects.
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXes_b6ylN7NarMcxIoHY9Bw0IniDxswg5o-BYeXG8W8Pys_hmpYHmkM8YbzTGx5lBPTlku6Vdx6bPRfkBDP2iuLwjlVMjE6Z_9x-x1upMLqBLKkbrfueTAFGf2IavpchqoNU8hTkWaKENboBns_ZlVj8z85MA?key=IpYmreUZadLWYYEh84XT1w"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Crew Abilities[/b][/h2][p]As you level your crew members, you can train them for the roles you want. Each of them has 6 ability categories - Navigation, Weaponry, Drone, General, Interaction, and Ultimate. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Navigation: [/b][/p][p]Active and passive abilities related to movement, maneuvering, dodging, and setting traps. They only work when the crew member mans the Navigation station.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weaponry:[/b][/p][p]Active attack abilities, passives, or masteries for certain types of weapons. Active weaponry abilities only work when the character mans the Weaponry station. Passive weaponry abilities work on the Weaponry and on any of the Deck stations. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Drone:[/b][/p][p]Passive abilities and masteries for certain types of weapons that can be mounted on the drone. They only work when the crew member mans the Drone station.[/p][p][/p][p][b]General:[/b]
Passive-only abilities that work regardless of which station the crew member operates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Interaction:[/b]
Abilities that are available upon interaction with certain types of objects, regardless of which station the crew member operates. For example: interact with enemy buildings to plunder them, or interact with asteroids to harvest minerals.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Ultimate:[/b][/p][p]Powerful abilities that can be used regardless of which station the character operates. The crew member marked as “Visor” contributes their Ultimate ability to the arsenal.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Abilities Display[/b][/h2][p]When you assign a crew member to a station, you will see all their abilities available for that station.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc8yLgnB4DJS087-DFNk-PsGWhBJgm5dAZf8l60CMPGDqjLgKpNwy-EUg8RU8sPRiS7K41_JMPm6OEoGQW7xjLLr7ro8mQrer8yuR5oqwQwYxAbxfX8davprBITvccif_XVOOE0nnR9HgpR_8cNXY2Hd0FXiko?key=IpYmreUZadLWYYEh84XT1w"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]At the bottom panel, you will see the arsenal of abilities based on the current crew layout. These abilities will be available to you in combat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcIm1j2FSQIQs5RSxrxcwGQy_N7Vm0K77IMbdV_lkibyZZxCjqE5x1kf5YgqK4xLrFQNvCiLDUPaCX7zmN_Ra5zBuuHFNnyGFnmzDS0Ak8OhTa36HSAUw_6qG0LvuYmjv8jDXzNLhLaN18Ar8_MMtY1WiLue9A?key=IpYmreUZadLWYYEh84XT1w"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Use in Combat[/b][/h2][p]Once you configure your crew layouts, you can switch between them in-game, during combat, by pressing the Quick Access buttons (1,2,3,4, etc). You can see the currently selected crew layout in the bottom left corner of the screen.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38252288/5895fb021168af7eb5cf0154f5ddba584f0cea34.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]What's next?[/b][/h2][p]Our next major milestone is a demo for Steam! We aim to release the demo in Q2 2026. But we will be posting updates once every 1-2 months[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us on:[url="https://discord.gg/bNKJYVj"] [/url][/p][p][u][url="https://discord.gg/bNKJYVj"]Discord[/url][/u][url="https://www.facebook.com/SolarSailsGame"] [/url][/p][p][u][url="https://www.facebook.com/SolarSailsGame"]Facebook[/url][/u][url="https://solarsailsgame.com/"] [/url][/p][p][u][url="https://solarsailsgame.com/"]Website[/url][/u][/p][p]
[/p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38252288/c2d8e896545809832f9f4a52f17ab374d5ff6cdd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Barvaz the Duck[/h2][p]Barvaz is a trained scout duck equipped with a jetpack and a time-manipulating device. Barvaz the Duck will be your valuable crew member and an important part of the gameplay.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38252288/5e56c2a97db60a527255bb81c1e4347704cbd802.gif"][/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Ahoy everyone!

We’ve achieved a major milestone in our development process - we've finished pre-production!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38252288/24cfcf46ee5b908bb8eca18c890fa7dda29ddf5a.gif[/img]

[h2]So far, we have:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Designed the gameplay mechanics - combat, progression, and exploration.
[*] Finalized the narrative - lore, story, characters, worlds, regions, and quests.
[*] Planned our characters, skill trees, abilities, ship upgrades, equipment, and crew systems.
[*] Designed enemies, boss fights, looting, and economy systems.
[*] Finalized 70% of the game’s art - enemies, ships, characters, UI, and icons.
[*] Upgraded our graphics.
[/list]
And now, we begin our production phase!


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
These are the things we are going to work on in the next few months:

[h3]Crew Members System[/h3]
The ship you control has operation modules - steering, weaponry, drone, mast, and deck - which must be manned by crew members. Each crew member has their own skill tree, with specialized abilities for each module. You can train and assign your crew members to specific modules, which impacts your arsenal of active and passive abilities. This allows you to experiment with different crew layouts and combat styles.

[h3]Scout Duck[/h3]
Apart from the ship, you can release and take control of Barvaz, a space duck with a jetpack. Barvaz can traverse narrow passages in asteroid fields, find secrets with his duck senses, and sabotage enemy defences and space stations.


[h2]What's the next goal?[/h2]
Our next major milestone is a demo for Steam!
We aim to release the demo around Q1/Q2 2026.


[h2]About Us[/h2]
A few words about us today - we are Cosmic Duck Games, a team of 10 passionate and professional game developers from several countries. Some worked on AAA titles. We are making progress, and now we will be sharing updates more frequently, so stay tuned!
